authority_basis.summary: Operator requested recording the Marici Big Bang supported-degeneration conjecture.

operations.title: Type the cosmological initial singularity without assuming a primitive origin event
operations.body: Determine whether the observable Big Bang is generated by supported degeneration of the frozen Marici carrier and sector-specific nearby-cycle coefficients, or requires a genuinely new cosmological carrier stratum.

operations.title: The observable Big Bang is a supported degeneration, not a primitive carrier point
operations.body: The cosmological initial singularity is a supported weighted/logarithmic degeneration of the common Marici carrier. Observable origin properties arise from sector-specific nearby-cycle coefficient objects, higher normal/Rees grades, global time-sheet data, and a source-derived physical specialization. This does not assert a literal first instant or that the coefficient systems are sector-independent.

operations.title: Initial-singularity carrier falsifier
operations.body: Freeze the energy/Cut carrier and admissible logarithmic or weighted-Rees resolutions. Compute the supported nearby-cycle object, higher normal grades, time-sheet action, and physical specialization. If the initial cosmological boundary requires an incidence stratum not generated by the frozen carrier and admissible resolution, the shared-carrier conjecture fails at this boundary.
